Proposal title: A Vision for interoperability in Element
Abstract:
Federation is working. But does the experience reflect it?
The goal of this collaborative workshop is to understand how interoperability and federation translates inside the product.
Together we’ll look at search, directories, shared rooms and how the experience can be tailored for users. 
We want to test our assumptions, hear what resonates and understand what we're missing. Your input will directly shape the product.
